milestones.title: Governance Policy Baseline
milestones.capability_unblocked: The repository has a small, versioned, executable policy layer for truthful milestone closure and safe future delivery.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M00

execution_brief.objective: Create the smallest enforceable governance baseline before adapter implementation.

context.source: AF milestone transition practices, extracted without AF runtime dependency

non_goals: Do not build adapters, a registry API, or a generic workflow runtime.
proof_requirements: Validator and tests pass.
Proof records exact command results.
stop_conditions: Stop and mark blocked if a policy cannot name an enforceable rule.

milestones.title: Repository Contract Foundation
milestones.capability_unblocked: A minimal, independently testable adapter library with one shared contract.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M01

execution_brief.objective: Implement one small adapter contract and isolated conformance entry points.
non_goals: Do not implement dynamic plugin loading or AF integration.
proof_requirements: Contract tests pass without credentials or network access.
stop_conditions: Stop if the proposed contract requires a framework runtime.

milestones.title: CS AI Lab Deployable Release

execution_brief.objective: Deploy and verify an immutable Tool Repository release on the CS AI Lab laptop.

context.delivery: Git tag to a non-root versioned installation

non_goals: Do not deploy an adapter-execution proxy, public ingress, a database, or an API before TR-M04.

milestones.title: Standard Tool Descriptor Schema
milestones.capability_unblocked: Tools have one validated descriptor that makes value, fit, limits, and lifecycle discoverable.

execution_brief.objective: Define and validate the canonical per-adapter descriptor.
non_goals: Do not maintain a second hand-written tool registry.
proof_requirements: Valid and invalid fixture manifests are distinguished.
stop_conditions: Stop if a descriptor field has no discovery, safety, testing, versioning, or contribution purpose.

milestones.title: Tool Knowledge Base Contract
milestones.capability_unblocked: The library can validate concise guides, evidenced usage learning, and clearly separated suggested uses.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M03

execution_brief.objective: Define a validated knowledge-base contract before migrating any real adapter.
non_goals: Do not claim an adapter has proven usage before it is migrated and tested.
proof_requirements: The validator distinguishes validated usage from suggested use.
stop_conditions: Stop if usage records would expose customer data, secrets, or unsupported claims.

milestones.title: Machine Discovery and Catalogue API
milestones.capability_unblocked: Solutions can discover approved adapters, resolve immutable releases, and retrieve value/use and knowledge links without executing adapter code.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M04

execution_brief.objective: Expose a read-only, generated catalogue that resolves trusted immutable adapter artifacts.

context.security: Manifest discovery must not import adapter code.

non_goals: Do not proxy adapter execution, secrets, configuration, logs, or arbitrary remote code.
proof_requirements: Fixtures prove malformed, untrusted, and checksum-mismatched releases are rejected.
stop_conditions: Stop if the design requires a database or stateful central service.

milestones.title: Reference Adapters and AF Extraction
milestones.capability_unblocked: Solutions can use a small, proven set of independently tested adapters migrated from or informed by AF.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M05

execution_brief.objective: Create clean-room T480 transport, lab, and MP4 transcription adapters with isolated tests.

context.provenance: Internal/proprietary reuse authorised by repository owner on 2026-08-29; source code is not copied.

non_goals: Do not copy source code, import machine-local configuration, expose arbitrary remote commands, or run live T480 operations by default.
proof_requirements: Default tests use fakes; live checks are opt-in and do not expose secrets.
stop_conditions: Stop if an adapter cannot be separated from application-specific assumptions or the source-use authorisation is withdrawn.

milestones.title: Solution Consumption and Contribution Loop
milestones.capability_unblocked: A new solution can resolve and use a pinned adapter, make a documented local fork, and contribute reusable improvements back.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M06

execution_brief.objective: Prove a solution can consume a pinned release and return a safe reusable change.
non_goals: Do not create a solution-local duplicate registry or make AF a dependency.
proof_requirements: Example resolves an exact version and preserves fork provenance.
stop_conditions: Stop if reuse requires a central control plane or unpinned mutable dependency.

milestones.title: Prompt Library and Execution Provenance
milestones.capability_unblocked: Reusable major prompts are versioned and solution executions have privacy-aware, auditable provenance.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M07

execution_brief.objective: Define a privacy-safe, versioned library for major prompts and execution provenance.
non_goals: Do not store hidden reasoning, credentials, private content, or a central execution log.
proof_requirements: Fixtures prove redacted records remain auditable and sensitive fields are rejected.
stop_conditions: Stop if full prompt capture violates the data classification policy.

milestones.title: Prompt Evaluation and Drift Correction
milestones.capability_unblocked: Prompt execution quality and drift are evidence-backed, measurable, visible, and corrected through controlled prompt versions.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository prompts evaluate --fixture examples/prompt-evaluation-fixture
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M08

execution_brief.objective: Measure prompt drift with reproducible fixtures, calibrated rubrics, and controlled correction proposals.
non_goals: Do not claim one opaque score proves prompt quality or auto-promote a prompt variant.
proof_requirements: Fixture shows a detected drift, evidence, a correction proposal, and a non-regression comparison.
verification_commands: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository prompts evaluate --fixture examples/prompt-evaluation-fixture
stop_conditions: Stop if evaluation cannot identify its data, rubric, evaluator settings, and known limitations.

milestones.title: Repository Asset Intake and Curation
milestones.capability_unblocked: Source repositories are assessed one at a time for reusable, lawful, safe assets before any code or solution structure is promoted.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M09

execution_brief.objective: Create a read-only, one-repository-at-a-time intake process for discovering reusable adapters, recipes, templates, prompts, schemas, and evaluation assets.
non_goals: Do not execute untrusted code, install source dependencies, bulk-clone repositories, or import code before a separate promotion decision.
proof_requirements: Assessment records source/revision/licence, evidence, security posture, reuse classification, destination, and promotion decision.
stop_conditions: Stop if source provenance or licence is unknown, or if safe inspection cannot be performed without executing untrusted code.

milestones.title: Proof and Review Integrity
milestones.capability_unblocked: New milestone closure evidence is bound to inspectable commits and saved review records.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M10

execution_brief.objective: Bind new proof and required reviews to inspectable repository evidence.
non_goals: Do not rewrite historical proof records.
proof_requirements: Proof records committed revision and hashed reviews.
stop_conditions: Stop if evidence cannot be bound to a commit.

milestones.title: Runtime Contract Enforcement
milestones.capability_unblocked: Adapter requests and successful results conform to their declared schemas before promotion.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M11

execution_brief.objective: Enforce runtime schemas and explicit descriptor conformance.
non_goals: Do not add an adapter execution service.
proof_requirements: Invalid input and output are rejected safely.
stop_conditions: Stop if validation requires importing code during discovery.

milestones.title: T480 Local Model Profiles
milestones.capability_unblocked: Solutions can discover approved local T480 Ollama model profiles, their exact installed digests, intended roles, and local-only safety boundary without treating mutable tags as sufficient identity.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M12

execution_brief.objective: Catalogue approved T480-local Ollama model profiles with exact installed digests and no remote execution endpoint.
non_goals: Do not expose Ollama port 11434, proxy generation, store prompts, or represent a mutable tag without its digest.
proof_requirements: Readback proves each published profile's exact local Ollama digest and local smoke evidence.
stop_conditions: Stop if a profile cannot be bound to an installed digest or the design requires exposing unauthenticated model execution.

milestones.title: T480 Core Model Rationalisation
milestones.capability_unblocked: Solutions discover only the two owner-approved, installed T480 core models: Qwen 3 4B and Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M13

execution_brief.objective: Remove non-core local models and publish only the owner-approved T480 Qwen core set.
non_goals: Do not expose a model endpoint or retain removed models in the active catalogue.
proof_requirements: Local readback proves exactly the two retained profile digests; bounded smokes prove both run locally.
stop_conditions: Stop if an unapproved model remains in the active catalogue or a retained digest fails local readback.

milestones.title: Unified Tool Ingestion Governance
milestones.capability_unblocked: Every milestone explicitly declares whether it ingests reusable tool assets, and applicable milestones have an enforceable source-to-proof-to-catalogue promotion path.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M14

execution_brief.objective: Make the catalogue ingestion flow a mandatory, verifiable concern for every milestone that promotes or retires reusable tool assets.
non_goals: Do not add a central execution service or retroactively alter historical proof observations.
proof_requirements: Validator rejects incomplete applicable ingestion declarations and requires their declared verification evidence in closure proof.
stop_conditions: Stop if applicable ingestion can be marked complete without declared source records and proof verification evidence.

milestones.title: Ollama Readiness Adapter Ingestion
milestones.capability_unblocked: A T480-local solution can invoke a reviewed, read-only adapter to verify that the exact catalogue-approved Ollama model inventory is reachable only through loopback.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M15

execution_brief.objective: Clean-room ingest a read-only Ollama readiness adapter from the assessed local CS AI Lab source patterns.
non_goals: Do not copy source code, pull or delete models, proxy generation, change runtime configuration, or expose port 11434.
proof_requirements: Proof demonstrates exact approved profiles through the local loopback inventory and proves the adapter rejects missing or mismatched inventory.
stop_conditions: Stop if a design needs a non-loopback URL, mutable model identity, model installation, or arbitrary request execution.

milestones.title: Prompt and Template Catalogue Ingestion
milestones.capability_unblocked: Solutions can discover approved reusable prompt definitions, human-approved goals, and governed operating templates from the read-only catalogue without receiving private execution content.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M16

execution_brief.objective: Publish validated prompt, approved-goal, and operating-template metadata through the read-only catalogue.

context.privacy: No raw private execution content is catalogue data.
context.approval_gate: Only an explicitly human-approved goal record may be published.

non_goals: Do not execute prompts, store raw prompt executions, or ingest product-specific prompts without review.
Do not publish a goal candidate before a human approval record exists.
required_outputs: versioned goal prompt and template source
proof_requirements: Build proves prompt definitions, templates, and approved goals are versioned, validated, and represented without raw execution content.
A negative test proves an unapproved goal cannot be published.
stop_conditions: Stop if a catalogue entry would contain raw inputs, outputs, hidden reasoning, credentials, or customer content.
Stop if explicit human approval cannot be validated.

milestones.title: Target Operating Model and Hosted Delivery Roadmap
milestones.capability_unblocked: Users and maintainers have a single, truthful operating model that maps current local discovery and release resolution to the staged Cloudflare-hosted delivery path.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M17

execution_brief.objective: Define the user-facing target operating model and create a truthful, sequenced hosted-delivery roadmap.

context.hosting_target: Cloudflare R2 and a stateless Worker
context.current_boundary: local/Git discovery and local adapter execution

non_goals: Do not claim the Cloudflare publisher, Worker, consumer HTTP client, or adapter installer exists before it is implemented.
Do not create a central adapter execution service.
proof_requirements: Proof validates the registry and confirms every operating-model capability has a matching milestone and truthful status.
stop_conditions: Stop if a capability is marked complete without checked-in evidence or a future hosted capability lacks a concrete delivery milestone.

milestones.title: Immutable Catalogue Publication to Cloudflare R2
milestones.capability_unblocked: GitHub CI can publish a validated, checksum-bound immutable catalogue object to a private Cloudflare R2 bucket with rollback-safe versioning.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M18

execution_brief.objective: Publish only generated, validated, immutable catalogue objects and checksums to private R2 through least-privilege CI.
non_goals: Do not upload adapter code, secrets, solution data, or mutable runtime state to R2.
proof_requirements: Proof demonstrates a non-production fixture publication and validates object version, checksum, and rollback selection.
stop_conditions: Stop if credentials can enter repository files, an unvalidated object can publish, or object versions cannot be selected for rollback.

milestones.title: Protected Cloudflare Worker Catalogue API
milestones.capability_unblocked: Authorised consumers can fetch immutable catalogue JSON through a stateless HTTPS endpoint that performs no adapter execution.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M19

execution_brief.objective: Serve the exact R2 catalogue object over a protected, stateless HTTPS API.
non_goals: Do not implement adapter execution, write endpoints, search indexing, customer data storage, or model proxying.
proof_requirements: Proof demonstrates authorised read-only retrieval, denial for unauthorised access, immutable version resolution, and no write or execution route.
stop_conditions: Stop if the Worker can mutate R2, execute an adapter, expose a secret, or serve an unvalidated catalogue object.

milestones.title: HTTP Catalogue Consumer and Release Resolver
milestones.capability_unblocked: A consuming repository can safely fetch, cache, validate, filter, and pin the hosted catalogue before resolving a local adapter release.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M20

execution_brief.objective: Add a bounded HTTP consumer that accepts only validated catalogue bytes, verifies checksums, and emits a lockable release selection.
non_goals: Do not automatically run downloaded adapter code or silently upgrade a pinned release.
proof_requirements: Proof covers successful verified fetch, checksum mismatch rejection, stale-cache behaviour, and an exact pinned selection.
stop_conditions: Stop if a consumer accepts unverified content, silently changes a pinned release, or executes received code.

milestones.title: Pinned Adapter Acquisition and Local Installation
milestones.capability_unblocked: A consumer can deliberately acquire and non-root install the exact adapter release selected from the catalogue, with verification and rollback.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M21

execution_brief.objective: Make exact release acquisition deliberate, non-root, hash-verified, and reversible for consuming solutions.

context.release_source: catalogue artifact URI and release lock

non_goals: Do not build a central package registry, auto-execute an adapter after download, or install outside a declared local root.
proof_requirements: Proof demonstrates selection of an exact immutable release, checksum verification, non-root installation, and rollback without network-side mutation.
stop_conditions: Stop if installation can escape the target root, accept a mutable ref, or execute adapter code implicitly.

milestones.title: Hosted Catalogue Operations and Service Assurance
milestones.capability_unblocked: The hosted catalogue can be operated as a dependable shared read-only service with access controls, observability, rollback, and incident procedures.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M22

execution_brief.objective: Make the deployed catalogue observable, access-controlled, testable, and recoverable without weakening its read-only boundary.
non_goals: Do not add central adapter execution, analytics containing customer data, or broad standing credentials.
proof_requirements: Proof demonstrates an authorised healthy read, denied unauthorised request, rollback exercise, and operational alert/smoke evidence.
stop_conditions: Stop if operations require exposing secrets, centralising customer data, or granting mutation rights to the Worker runtime.

milestones.title: Pt Chev Calendar Asset Intake and Template Ingestion
milestones.capability_unblocked: Solutions can discover a privacy-safe public iCalendar reader contract template and reference pattern while the executable adapter remains a human-gated clean-room candidate.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M23

execution_brief.objective: Ingest the agreed Pt Chev public-calendar contract template, candidate knowledge, and reference pattern without promoting unverified executable source code.

context.source: Success by CS MIT-licensed Pt Chev Water Times
context.external_gate: calendar-feed terms and permitted fields require human approval

non_goals: Do not copy the source Edge Function, publish an active calendar adapter, fetch an external feed, or ingest source environment values, user feedback, branded UI, or raw calendar data.
required_outputs: validated intake assessment and lift plan
proof_requirements: Proof demonstrates source assessment validation and template catalogue inclusion while recording that executable promotion remains blocked on external-feed authority and clean-room tests.
stop_conditions: Stop if an unapproved external feed, source code, secret, user content, or executable adapter is published through this milestone.

milestones.title: Calendar Event Time-Normalisation Fixture and Template Ingestion
milestones.capability_unblocked: Solutions can discover an explicit calendar time-normalisation template and synthetic fixture set without relying on an executable source adapter.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M24

execution_brief.objective: Publish an explicit, testable normalisation template and synthetic fixtures for the Pt Chev calendar pattern.

context.source: MIT-licensed Pt Chev Water Times assessment

non_goals: Do not copy source code, fetch a live feed, infer timezones, or make editorial title text implicitly authoritative.

milestones.title: Public Read-only Data Proxy Control Pattern Ingestion
milestones.capability_unblocked: Solutions can discover a reusable control template and pattern for a future clean-room, public-source, read-only proxy without centralising adapter execution.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M25

execution_brief.objective: Publish a clean-room data-proxy control template and reference pattern, preserving the local-execution boundary.

context.source: MIT-licensed Pt Chev Water Times assessment

non_goals: Do not publish source proxy code, deploy a proxy, permit arbitrary URLs, or centralise execution.
proof_requirements: Proof demonstrates the catalogue entry and tests confirming the no-arbitrary-URL, explicit-CORS, durable-control, and read-only constraints.
stop_conditions: Stop if the asset contains executable source code, provider credentials, a user-data path, or a central adapter execution service.

milestones.title: Privacy-Governed Feedback Capability Decision
milestones.capability_unblocked: A future feedback capability has a decision gate that prevents reusable intake until privacy, retention, anti-abuse, and operating ownership are approved.
verify: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tool_repository milestones close-check TR-M26

execution_brief.objective: Obtain and record the decisions required before any reusable feedback asset can be designed or ingested.

context.data_risk: feedback can contain personal, sensitive, or abusive content

non_goals: Do not build a feedback form, database, API, or catalogue asset before written human approval.
proof_requirements: Proof must include explicit human approval for each decision and negative tests that prevent publication without it.
stop_conditions: Stop if a personal-data path, anonymous submission endpoint, or feedback content is introduced before all required approvals exist.
